notes.title: Big Announcement! Legendary Composer Yuzo Koshiro to Compose Algolemeth's BGM!
notes.content:
🎉 Big Announcement! 🎉

[previewyoutube=jSc-CnW27F4;full][/previewyoutube]

The BGM for the fully-automated dungeon RPG Algolemeth will be composed by none other than the legendary Yuzo Koshiro, known for his work on many classic titles!

All tracks in this game are created using Sega Genesis-style FM synthesis.
This hot, retro-inspired sound will energize both your dungeon exploration and strategic battles!

As someone who has admired Koshiro since childhood, I’m overjoyed that he kindly agreed to this dream collaboration.

Despite being an indie developer, he warmly accepted my request, and I am deeply grateful. I also want to sincerely thank everyone who helped make this dream come true.

🎮 You can get an early experience of Koshiro's music at Tokyo Game Dungeon 8 on May 4th!
Please stop by booth 2F-8!

I will continue moving forward, aiming to create a game that not only meets your expectations, but excites me more than anyone.

Thank you so much for your support!

notes.title: New Main Visual Revealed! & Exhibiting at Tokyo Game Dungeon 7!
notes.content:
New Main Visual Revealed!

Hello! I'm Gunzee (@gunzee2), the developer of Algolemeth!  

Today, we’re excited to unveil the brand-new main visual for Algolemeth!  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44794881/48a6495bbae9cbcbfe860f626776a837dc194515.png  

This stunning artwork was created by @sanaki385!  

I've wanted to update the main visual and character portraits for a long time, and now that dream has finally come true! This was made possible thanks to GYAARCon’s development support, which connected me with an amazing artist. Huge thanks to everyone involved!  

New PV Released!  

Alongside the new visual, we’ve also updated the PV! While the structure remains the same, most of the footage has been replaced with the latest in-game visuals. Be sure to check out the new title logo reveal!  

[previewyoutube=km0wWATFf_4;full][/previewyoutube]  

We’ve also updated all the images on the store page, so if you’d like to take a closer look, be sure to check it out.  

And while you're there, don’t forget to add Algolemeth to your wishlist!  

Exhibiting at Tokyo Game Dungeon 7 on 2/15/2025!  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44794881/13e68e0806c65a8945452d348af9166eb22352e1.png  

On Saturday, February 15, Algolemeth will be exhibited at Tokyo Game Dungeon 7 in Hamamatsucho, Tokyo! Our booth number is D-6!  

We'll be bringing the latest playable build, featuring the new visuals and tons of improvements from a year ago! The game has evolved significantly, merging exploration and combat - so come try it out and share your thoughts!  
(Warning: it might be a bit more complex than before...)  

This marks my first solo exhibition in about a year, so I apologize in advance for any rough spots! Looking forward to seeing you all next week!  

A Big Announcement Coming Soon…!?  

And lastly, a little teaser - within the next few months, we might have an exciting announcement to share!  

Just to clarify, this won't be the release date reveal just yet. But when the time comes, I believe many of you will be thrilled to hear it! Stay tuned for upcoming updates!  

Thank you for your continued support!

notes.title: Algolemeth heading to Tokyo Game Show 2024!!
notes.content:
Announcement!

We are excited to announce that Algolemeth will be showcased at Tokyo Game Show 2024!

Just like at our previous appearance at gamescom, we will be exhibiting thanks to winning the “2nd GYAAR Studio Indie Game Contest.” We are truly grateful for this opportunity!

At this exhibition, you’ll be able to play the latest build of Algolemeth! The developers will also be attending the event on September 28th and 29th. Please drop by the booth and share your thoughts with us directly!

At the GYAAR Studio booth, you’ll also find various other contest-winning and publishing titles, along with giveaways. Make sure to enjoy this opportunity to the fullest!

Event Schedule

Business Days: Thursday, September 26, 2024 - Friday, September 27, 2024
Public Days: Saturday, September 28, 2024 - Sunday, September 29, 2024

Exhibition Location

Makuhari Messe, Halls 9-11, Indie Game Corner C30, "Phoenixx / GYAAR Studio" Booth

Booth Details
https://indie.bandainamcostudios.com/tgs2024
